title: Find the Duplicate Number
summary: Return the only value that appears more than once.

contractDetails.constraints: The array has n + 1 entries for 1 ≤ n ≤ 100,000. All entries are integers from 1 through n. Exactly one distinct value occurs at least twice. Every other value that is present occurs once.

statement: Return the only value that appears more than once. Keep the input array unchanged and use constant auxiliary space.

examples.explanation: The repeated value can occur more than twice.
The two entries must both be 1.

constraints: The array has n + 1 entries for 1 ≤ n ≤ 100,000. All entries are integers from 1 through n. Exactly one distinct value occurs at least twice. Every other value that is present occurs once.
hints: Conceptual: More than one index points to the repeated value if each entry is interpreted as a next index.
Directional: Starting at index zero gives a path that eventually loops. Use two speeds to meet inside that loop.
Implementation: After the meeting, restart one pointer at index zero. Advance both pointers one step at a time. Their next meeting is the cycle entrance.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space with two pointer phases.
